description: This script implements a command-line tool for running web page load experiments using either wget or a custom quic_client. It includes functions for timestamp generation, a class for managing the experiment, reading page URLs from a JSON file, downloading pages, and running multiple iterations of the experiment, outputting delay and packet data to CSV files.

classes.name: PageloadExperiment
classes.description: Manages the setup and execution of web page load experiments using wget or quic_client, including reading URLs from a JSON file, downloading pages, and recording delay and packet data.

methods.name: Timestamp
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp in microseconds or converts a given datetime to a timestamp in microseconds.

methods.name: PageloadExperiment.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the experiment with options for using wget, binary directory, server address, and port.

methods.name: PageloadExperiment.ReadPages
methods.description: Reads a JSON file containing page URLs and resources, returning a list of URL lists for each page.

methods.name: PageloadExperiment.DownloadOnePage
methods.description: Downloads a page (or resource list) using wget or quic_client, returning download time and max packet number.

methods.name: PageloadExperiment.RunExperiment
methods.description: Runs the experiment for a specified number of iterations, recording delays and packet counts into CSV files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that parses command-line options, initializes the experiment, and runs it.
